lidc_analysis.root_cause: Latency variance is driven by input volume heterogeneity: small volumes fit within a single 128x128x128 patch (direct inference, mean 178.6ms), while large volumes trigger sliding-window multi-patch inference (mean 4410.4ms). The distribution is strictly bimodal with zero transitional cases. Load time serves as a strong proxy for volume size (Pearson r=0.9552 with inference). The coefficient of variation drops from 104.2% to 75.9% after removing 15 IQR outliers (7.5%).

g0_vs_g4inf.explanation: G0 independent measurement yields higher values (mean 76.78ms vs 51.47ms) due to GPU cold-start / warm-up effects. The 25.31ms difference is uncorrelated with input size (G0 vs WADO_MB r=-0.069, G0 vs RawVoxel r=-0.068), confirming it reflects measurement methodology rather than protocol contamination.

proto_analysis.root_cause: The 24.44% max error comes from a single case (Recon 2 CHEST, 50MB WADO transfer) where G0 baseline measurement jittered (G0=145.2ms vs G4=345.1ms). Error correlates strongly with G0 instability (Spearman rho=0.7432), not with protocol layers. After removing top-1 outlier, mean error drops to 3.19%. L2-L4 layers remain <1ms across all cases, confirming protocol overhead is dominated by L1 transport (WADO retrieval).
